data.name: Nasirah
data.gender_notes: Nasirah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nasirah is an Arabic name that denotes a helper or supporter. It carries a sense of assistance and aid. In Islamic tradition, Nasirah is associated with the qualities of kindness and empathy. The name Nasirah carries the meaning “Helper, Supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nasirah usually hope their child will grow to embody helper, supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Nasirah is a name that reflects the qualities of Allah's helpers and supporters in the Quran. It is a reminder of the importance of assisting and supporting one another in times of need.
data.etymology: Nasirah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helper, Supporter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nasirah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: ناصرة
in_arabic.meaning: ناصرة تعني الشخصية التي تساعد و تدعم الآخرين
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ناصرة مشتق من الجذر العربي ن-ص-ر، ويعني الشخصية التي تساعد و تدعم الآخرين في الشدائد و الظروف الصعبة. ورد ذكر هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وَكَانَ النَّاسُ أَكْثَرَ مِنَ الْفِرَقِ وَالْحُزُونِ وَلَم يَكُنْ أَحَدٌ يَذْكُرُ النَّصْرَ إِلَّا كَذَّبُوهُ وَأَبَوهُ' (الأنبياء: ٩٥). وتُعدّ ناصرة من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني القوة و الدعم و المساندة.

in_urdu.name: ناصرہ
in_urdu.meaning: ناصرہ کا مطلب ہے معاون اور مددگار شخصیت
in_urdu.long_meaning: ناصرہ نام عربی جڑ ن-ص-ر سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے معاون اور مددگار شخصیت۔ یہ نام ان شخصیات کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو دوسروں کی مدد اور حمایت کرتی ہیں۔ قرآن مجید میں بھی اس جڑ کا ذکر ہے، جیسے کہ ارشاد ربانی: 'وَلَيَنصُرَنَّ اللّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُ' (الحج: ٤٠). مسلم معاشرے میں ناصرہ نام کی اہمیت اس کی دینی اور ثقافتی پس منظر کی وجہ سے ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नासिरा
in_hindi.meaning: नासिरा का अर्थ है सहायक और मददगार व्यक्तित्व
in_hindi.long_meaning: नासिरा नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल न-ص-र से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है सहायक और मददगार व्यक्तित्व। यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो दूसरों की सहायता और समर्थन करती हैं। कुरआन में भी इस मूल का उल्लेख है, जैसे कि 'وَلَيَنصُرَنَّ اللّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُ' (الحج: ٤٠)। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में नासिरा नाम का महत्व इसकी धार्मिक और सांस्कृतिक पृष्ठभूमि के कारण है।

in_pashto.name: ناصره
in_pashto.meaning: ناصره د مرستي او ملاتړ کوونکي شخصیت معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: ناصره نوم د عربي جڑ ن-ص-ر څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د مرستي او ملاتړ کوونکي شخصیت معنی لري. دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي چي د نورو سره مرسته او حمايت کوي. په قرآن کريم کې د دې جڑ يادونه ده، لکه د الله تعالى فرماي: 'وَلَيَنصُرَنَّ اللّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُ' (الحج: ٤٠). په افغان او پښتون دود کې ناصره نوم د هغې ديني او کلتوري شاليدې له امله اهميت لري.

in_english.name: Nasirah
in_english.meaning: Supportive and helpful personality, derived from Arabic root n-ṣ-r
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nasirah is derived from the Arabic root n-ṣ-r, which means supportive and helpful personality. This name is given to individuals who assist and support others in times of need. The root is mentioned in the Quran, such as in 'وَلَيَنصُرَنَّ اللّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُ' (الحج: ٤٠). Nasirah signifies strength, support, and compassion, reflecting the Islamic values of solidarity and brotherhood. The name is used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing a person who provides aid and support to others.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nasirah carries a rich cultural significance in the Islamic world. It is a name that has been passed down through generations and is often given to girls as a sign of love, admiration, and respect. The name conveys a sense of strength, support, and reliability. It is a name that is highly valued in Muslim communities, as it reflects the Islamic ideals of family, community, and support.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Nasirah is a name that evokes the qualities of kindness, empathy, and love. In Islamic tradition, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) was a great supporter and helper to those around him. He reached out to the downtrodden, the poor, and the distressed, offering them comfort, support, and guidance. The Prophet Muhammad emphasized the importance of helping one another and caring for each other's needs. By giving the name Nasirah to a child, parents are acknowledging the spiritual importance of these qualities and inspiring their child to embody them throughout their life. Additionally, Nasirah can be seen as a reminder of the role of Allah (SWT) as the ultimate supporter and helper, as denoted in the faith's central prayer, the Shahada, which states "There is no deity but Allah, the Helper (Nasir) of the believers."
